title: Serve executor
description: `nx serve <app>` — a thin wrapper over the stack-free dev engine (`tools/dev/dev serve <app>`), which runs every process the app declares in `.bespunky/dev.json` (the dev-server; the Firebase emulator suite in a Firebase workspace; anything hand-declared) under ONE graceful Ctrl+C, for the current git worktree or any chosen one (--worktree=<branch|slug|path>), on one port offset for every declared port (--port-offset; the main tree prefers the base ports), reached at `<slug>.localhost` in the shared co-driven browser. Options it does not own are forwarded to the app's primary process (buildTarget, host, proxyConfig, ssl, … for an Angular dev-server); the development/production configurations live on this target (nx serve <app> --configuration=production).

project.description: Project whose dev-server to run. Defaults to the project this executor target is attached to.

emulators.description: Historic alias: `--no-emulators` is `--skip=emulators` (the Firebase adapter's process). The app opens with `?emulate=none`, so every service resolves to the real backend. A no-op, said so, on an app that declares no `emulators` process.

sharedBrowser.description: Bring up the shared co-driven browser (noVNC, on a per-container allocated port whose URL is printed) and navigate it to the app. `--no-shared-browser` serves headless. A missing browser dependency is warned and skipped — it never fails the serve.

buildTarget.description: The app build target the dev-server compiles. Set by serve's `development`/`production` configurations (→ `<app>:build:<config>`) and forwarded to the primary process (the `dev-server` leaf); run `nx serve <app> --configuration=production` to pick one.

host.description: Dev-server host, forwarded to the primary process (the `dev-server` leaf) (default 0.0.0.0 so it's reachable from outside the devcontainer).

proxyConfig.description: Proxy config path, forwarded to the primary process (the `dev-server` leaf).

ssl.description: Serve over HTTPS (forwarded to the primary process).

sslCert.description: SSL certificate path (forwarded to the primary process).

sslKey.description: SSL key path (forwarded to the primary process).

open.description: Open the app in a browser on start (forwarded to the primary process).

liveReload.description: Toggle live-reload (forwarded to the primary process).

hmr.description: Toggle HMR (forwarded to the primary process).

poll.description: File-watch poll interval in ms (forwarded to the primary process).

worktree.description: Which git worktree to serve. Omit to serve the current cwd's tree; pass a value to match by branch name, DNS slug, or path; pass an empty value in an interactive terminal to pick one from an arrow-key prompt.

portOffset.description: Isolate the whole stack — every port the app declares — on one offset block, sized from the declared ports. 'auto' gives the MAIN tree the base ports when free and each worktree a stable, verified-free block; a non-negative integer pins one; '0' forces the base stack. Pass it as `--port-offset` (Nx maps it here).

install.description: Run the declaration's install step in the chosen worktree when it lacks what the step `creates` (fresh worktrees start empty). `--no-install` refuses instead.

dryRun.description: Print the resolved tree, offset block, every process with its command, ports and env, and the URLs — without installing, serving, or touching the browser.

skip.description: Declared process ids NOT to run (comma-separated or repeated), e.g. `--skip=emulators`. The primary process cannot be skipped.

port.description: IGNORED (warned): a served port is declared in `.bespunky/dev.json` (processes[].ports) and shifted by --port-offset — set the base port there.
